description: Find listings by describing what you want in everyday language, such as returned kitchen appliances in bulk. No sign-in required. Semantic matches include similarity from 0 to 1 and match_type semantic. When the embedding index is empty or no provider is configured, results use keyword search, similarity is null, and match_type is keyword_fallback. category, when set, is one catalogue category such as electronics. max_price is the maximum unit price in cents.

category.description: Limit to one catalogue category. One of: electronics, apparel, home_goods, beauty, sports, kitchenware, office_supplies, toys, food_beverage, tools, other.

condition.description: Condition of the goods: salvage (sold as-is), customer returns, shelf pulls, overstock, or new or refurbished.

limit.description: Number of ranked results to return

max_price.description: Maximum price per unit in cents

query.description: Natural-language description of what the buyer wants

name: search_inventory_semantic
title: Semantic inventory search
